evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet internals in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.
rationale: Removes redundant assertions and slightly clarifies code paths now that legacy wallets cannot be loaded normally. As stated in the PR description, the goal is reducing developer cognitive load ("Seeing too many of these assertions in the CWallet class while reading the code is cognitively loaded"), making this an internal cleanup with no user-facing or security impact.
